description.en:
Makes a character walk or run to a position: it sets the motion _speed[1] (CMND_SET_MOTION), then calls CMND_CHR_POS_VAL_TRG(_hdl, [x, y, z], 999, 0, _speed[0]).
ie4_ev_main.nut provides ready-made _speed pairs: S_WALK_01 = [0.3, "歩き前01"], S_WALK_07 = [0.3, "歩き前07"], S_RUN_01 = [1.0, "走り前01"], S_RUN_07 = [1.0, "走り前07"]. Wait for the end with WaitEvLowMdlMoving.
[speed, motion name], e.g. S_WALK_01 or S_RUN_01.

examples.case: Walking to a spot (real usage, from ev42010600.nut)
